title: The Asking
summary: He asks to go back for a day. She has been waiting for this question longer than he has been alive, and she says yes, because the only other answer is to become his gaoler.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley in warm light, silver waterfalls falling into the still lake, wildflowers in the grass. Nothing moves but the water. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The warrior stands alone at the lake edge, small in the frame, not looking at any of it. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face in warm light. He has rehearsed this and it is still difficult. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I want to go back for one day. Not to stay. To stand in my father's field and see who is farming it, and then come home to you before the light goes.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them a few paces apart on the grass, facing each other, the waterfall behind them. Neither moves. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face. She has been expecting this question for a long time. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have been waiting for you to ask that since the second week. Not dreading it. Waiting. A man who never asked would not have been worth bringing.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face, caught out and relieved at once. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then say no. If you say no I will not ask again. I would rather be told than spend another year working out how to phrase it.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face, steady, deciding in front of him. Static camera.

dialogue.line: If I say no I stop being the woman you came away with and start being the one who keeps you. I will not do that. So it is yes, and I will hate every hour of it.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them on the grass, closer now, the valley enormous around them. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face. This is the part she has rehearsed. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Take the white horse and keep your hand on the bridle. Do not get down. Not for a stone, not for a man, not for your father's field. The ground there is not the ground you left.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face, promising easily because it costs him nothing to promise. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I will not get down. I am not going there to farm. I am going to look, and then I am coming back to be insufferable about how little has changed.

scenes.visual: Extreme wide shot. The warrior walks away along the lake path, small in the frame, unhurried. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face, watching him go, saying it to nobody. Static camera.

dialogue.line: He said before the light goes. He believes that. I have never once met anyone who came back before the light goes.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of the valley in warm light, the waterfalls falling, the lake still, the path empty. Static camera.
